# Layout Editor style sample

`Sample.keymap` and `Sample.conf` are written by hand in the shape the MoErgo Layout Editor's
export has (`layer_<Name>` nodes, `LAYER_<Name>` defines, `hm: homerow_mods` hold-taps, a macros
block, a combos block, `&mt` overrides). Nothing here came from MoErgo's tool: the real export
from BK is still pending, so this covers what the template's default keymap lacks (modelled
hold-taps, macros and combos) and is not evidence of what the Layout Editor emits.
